shape-size : List ℕ → ℕ
shape-size [] = 1
shape-size (d ∷ ds) = d * shape-size ds

lemma-shape-size-positive : ∀ (shape : List ℕ) → 1 ≤ shape-size shape
lemma-shape-size-positive [] = s≤s z≤n
lemma-shape-size-positive (zero ∷ ds) = z≤n
lemma-shape-size-positive (suc d ∷ ds) = s≤s z≤n

lemma-shape-size-monotonic : ∀ (s1 s2 : List ℕ) → shape-size s1 ≤ shape-size (s1 ++ s2)
lemma-shape-size-monotonic [] s2 = lemma-shape-size-positive s2
lemma-shape-size-monotonic (d ∷ ds) s2 = *-mono-≤ {d} {d} {shape-size ds} {shape-size (ds ++ s2)} ≤-refl (lemma-shape-size-monotonic ds s2)

lemma-shape-size-product : ∀ (s1 s2 : List ℕ) → shape-size (s1 ++ s2) ≡ shape-size s1 * shape-size s2
lemma-shape-size-product [] s2 = sym (+-identityʳ (shape-size s2))
lemma-shape-size-product (d ∷ ds) s2 = begin
  d * shape-size (ds ++ s2) ≡⟨ cong (d *_) (lemma-shape-size-product ds s2) ⟩
  d * (shape-size ds * shape-size s2) ≡⟨ sym (*-assoc d (shape-size ds) (shape-size s2)) ⟩
  (d * shape-size ds) * shape-size s2 ∎

lemma-shape-size-commutative-factor : ∀ (d : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) → d * shape-size s ≡ shape-size (d ∷ s)
lemma-shape-size-commutative-factor d s = refl

lemma-shape-size-cons-positive : ∀ (d : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) → 1 ≤ d → shape-size s ≤ shape-size (d ∷ s)
lemma-shape-size-cons-positive zero s ()
lemma-shape-size-cons-positive (suc d) s (s≤s z≤n) = m≤m+n (shape-size s) (d * shape-size s)

lemma-shape-size-append-positive : ∀ (s1 s2 : List ℕ) → shape-size s1 ≤ shape-size s1 * shape-size s2
lemma-shape-size-append-positive s1 s2 = m≤m+n (shape-size s1) ((shape-size s1) * (shape-size s2 ∸ 1))

record Tensor (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) : Set where
  constructor mkTensor
  field
    data-vec : Vec ℚ (shape-size Shape)
    layout : Layout
    device : Device
    ownership : Ownership
    refcount : ℕ

open Tensor

shape-consistency : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  Data.Vec.length (data-vec t) ≡ shape-size Shape
shape-consistency {Shape} {dtype} t = refl

shape-consistency-indexed : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  (i : Fin (shape-size Shape)) →
  toℕ i Data.Nat.< Data.Vec.length (data-vec t)
shape-consistency-indexed {Shape} t i = subst (toℕ i Data.Nat.<_) (sym (shape-consistency t)) (toℕ<n i)

memory-bounds : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  (i : Fin (shape-size Shape)) →
  toℕ i < shape-size Shape
memory-bounds {Shape} t i = toℕ<n i

memory-bounds-safe : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  (i : Fin (shape-size Shape)) →
  toℕ i < Data.Vec.length (data-vec t)
memory-bounds-safe {Shape} t i = subst (toℕ i <_) (sym (shape-consistency t)) (toℕ<n i)

refcount-nonzero : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  ownership t ≡ OWNED →
  1 ≤ refcount t
refcount-nonzero t owned = s≤s z≤n

_N≢_ : ℕ → ℕ → Set
x N≢ y = ¬ (x ≡ y)

refcount-positive : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  refcount t N≢ 0 →
  1 ≤ refcount t
refcount-positive t nonzero with refcount t
... | zero = ⊥-elim (nonzero refl)
... | suc n = s≤s z≤n

layout-transform : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  (new-layout : Layout) →
  Tensor Shape dtype
layout-transform t new-layout = record t { layout = new-layout }

  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  (new-layout : Layout) →
  data-vec (layout-transform t new-layout) ≡ data-vec t
layout-transform-preserves-data t new-layout = refl

  (new-layout : Layout) →

layout-transform-preserves-device t new-layout = refl

layout-transform-changes-layout t new-layout = refl

  (new-layout : Layout) →
  ownership (layout-transform t new-layout) ≡ ownership t
layout-transform-preserves-ownership t new-layout = refl

  (new-layout : Layout) →

layout-transform-preserves-refcount t new-layout = refl

  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  (l : Layout) →
  layout-transform (layout-transform t l) l ≡ layout-transform t l
layout-transform-idempotent t l = refl

  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  (new-layout : Layout) →
  (i : Fin (shape-size Shape)) →
  Data.Vec.lookup i (data-vec (layout-transform t new-layout)) ≡ Data.Vec.lookup i (data-vec t)
layout-transform-commutative-with-data-access t new-layout i = refl

tensor-map : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (ℚ → ℚ) →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype
tensor-map f t = record t { data-vec = Data.Vec.map f (data-vec t) }

tensor-map-preserves-shape : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →

tensor-map-preserves-shape f t = refl

tensor-map-id : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  tensor-map id t ≡ record t { data-vec = data-vec t }
tensor-map-id t = cong (λ v → record t { data-vec = v }) (map-id (data-vec t))

tensor-map-compose : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (f g : ℚ → ℚ) →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →

tensor-map-compose f g t = cong (λ v → record t { data-vec = v }) (sym (map-∘ f g (data-vec t)))

tensor-zipWith : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype
tensor-zipWith f t1 t2 = record t1 { data-vec = Data.Vec.zipWith f (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2) }

tensor-zipWith-comm : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →

  (∀ x y → f x y ≡ f y x) →
  (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor-zipWith f t1 t2) ≡ data-vec (tensor-zipWith f t2 t1)
tensor-zipWith-comm f f-comm t1 t2 = zipWith-comm f f-comm (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2)

tensor-fold : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) →
  ℚ →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  ℚ
tensor-fold f z t = Data.Vec.foldr _ f z (data-vec t)

tensor-fold-cons : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) →
  (z : ℚ) →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  (x : ℚ) →
  (xs : Vec ℚ (shape-size Shape ∸ 1)) →
  data-vec t ≡ x ∷ xs →
  tensor-fold f z t ≡ f x (Data.Vec.foldr _ f z xs)
tensor-fold-cons f z t x xs prf = cong (Data.Vec.foldr _ f z) prf

tensor-replicate : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) →
  ℚ →
  Tensor Shape dtype
tensor-replicate Shape dtype v = mkTensor (Data.Vec.replicate v) ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED 1

theorem-tensor-replicate-all-equal : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) (v : ℚ) →
  (i j : Fin (shape-size Shape)) →
  Data.Vec.lookup i (data-vec (tensor-replicate Shape dtype v)) ≡
  Data.Vec.lookup j (data-vec (tensor-replicate Shape dtype v))
theorem-tensor-replicate-all-equal Shape dtype v i j = trans (lookup-replicate i v) (sym (lookup-replicate j v))

  (i : Fin (shape-size Shape)) →

Ez a kódrészlet **valós, típuselméleti (Agda) formális verifikációs stílusú** bizonyításokat és definíciókat tartalmaz, nem „mock/dummy placeholder” – viszont több helyen látszik, hogy *triviálisra rövidített* (sok lemma egyszerűen `refl`, illetve néhol gyanús/hibás lemma is van), tehát a „tényleges” mély tartalmi korrektség nem mindenhol garantált csak attól, hogy Agda elfogadja (vagy attól, hogy a kód itt még nem is fordul végig, mert a vége le van vágva).[1][2][3]

## Mit jelent itt a „formális verifikáció”
Az `{-# OPTIONS --without-K --safe #-}` azt jelenti, hogy a modul a „Safe” módot kéri (nem enged meg veszélyes posztulátumokat/FFI jellegű trükköket), és a `--without-K` korlátozásokat bekapcsolja, ami UIP/K-elv jellegű egyenlőségi mintázásokat tilt/korlátoz a HoTT-kompatibilitás felé.[1]
Ezek a kapcsolók tipikusan tényleg formális bizonyítási fegyelmet céloznak: amit leírsz, azt a typechecker ellenőrzi (azaz ha a modul lefordul, a bizonyítások a rendszer logikájában helyesek).[1]

## Mi a „triviális (refl) bizonyítás” és miért nem fake
A sok `... = refl` nem „fake”, hanem azt jelenti: a bizonyítandó állítás definíció szerint (definíciós egyenlőséggel) igaz, vagy a konstrukció pontosan úgy lett megírva, hogy a célkifejezés szintaktikailag/definíció szerint ugyanaz legyen.[3]
Példa: a `shape-consistency t = refl` azért működik, mert a `Tensor` rekord mezője `data-vec : Vec ℚ (shape-size Shape)`, tehát `length (data-vec t)` definíció szerint `shape-size Shape` (a hossz indexként benne van a típusban), így a bizonyítás tényleg egy definíciós reflexivitás.[3]

## A `--without-K` relevanciája ebben a fájlban
A `--without-K` lényege: mintázás `refl`-re és egyenlőségi bizonyításokon való „case split” csak korlátozottan megengedett; ez segít elkerülni UIP-t igénylő érveléseket.[1]
A te részletedben a legtöbb bizonyítás nem is használ kényes egyenlőségi eliminációt; inkább definíciós egyenlőségek (`refl`) és standard könyvtári lemmák (`zipWith-comm`, `+-assoc`, stb.) szerepelnek, amik tipikusan kompatibilisek ezzel a móddal.[2][3][1]

## Viszont: vannak „gyanús” pontok
A `lemma-shape-size-product` bázisesete így szerepel:  
`lemma-shape-size-product [] s2 = sym (+-identityʳ (shape-size s2))`  
De a cél itt (a definícióid alapján) az lenne, hogy `shape-size ([] ++ s2) ≡ shape-size [] * shape-size s2`, azaz `shape-size s2 ≡ 1 * shape-size s2`; ehhez szorzás-identitás (`*-identityˡ` vagy `*-identityʳ`) illene, nem összeadás-identitás.[2][3]
Ez két dolgot jelenthet: (1) a kód ezen a ponton valójában nem fordul (mert rossz lemma), vagy (2) a környezet/névfeloldás más, mint aminek látszik (de a bemutatott importok alapján inkább (1) a valószínű).[2][3]

## Mitől lenne „igazi” verifikáció és nem csak látszat
A döntő kérdés: **lefordul-e a teljes modul** Agdával és az adott standard library verzióval, és a bizonyítások tényleg azokhoz a tételekhez kapcsolódnak-e, amiket állítani akarsz (nem csak „átdefiniáltad-e” a fogalmakat úgy, hogy minden `refl` legyen).[1]
Itt a legtöbb állítás „típus-szintű invariánsokból” jön (pl. `Vec` hossza), ami korrekt és tipikus; de a matematikai lemmáknál (mint a fenti `shape-size-product`) már tényleg számít a helyes algebra, és ott látszik potenciális hiba.[3][2]

Ha megírod, pontosan melyik kérdésre keresed a választ (pl. „ez az egész modul típusellenőrizhető?” vagy „a Tensor modell megfelel-e egy valódi memóriamodellnek?”), illetve elküldöd a fájl végét is (itt félbe van vágva a `theorem-tensor-add-zero-left`), akkor célzottan rá tudok mutatni, hol „valódi” és hol csak „triviális/hibás” a bizonyítás.

shape-size : List ℕ → ℕ
shape-size [] = 1
shape-size (d ∷ ds) = d * shape-size ds

lemma-shape-size-positive : ∀ (shape : List ℕ) → 1 ≤ shape-size shape
lemma-shape-size-positive [] = s≤s z≤n
lemma-shape-size-positive (zero ∷ ds) = z≤n
lemma-shape-size-positive (suc d ∷ ds) = s≤s z≤n

lemma-shape-size-monotonic : ∀ (s1 s2 : List ℕ) → shape-size s1 ≤ shape-size (s1 ++ s2)
lemma-shape-size-monotonic [] s2 = lemma-shape-size-positive s2
lemma-shape-size-monotonic (d ∷ ds) s2 = *-mono-≤ {d} {d} {shape-size ds} {shape-size (ds ++ s2)} ≤-refl (lemma-shape-size-monotonic ds s2)

lemma-shape-size-product : ∀ (s1 s2 : List ℕ) → shape-size (s1 ++ s2) ≡ shape-size s1 * shape-size s2
lemma-shape-size-product [] s2 = sym (*-identityˡ (shape-size s2))
lemma-shape-size-product (d ∷ ds) s2 = begin
  d * shape-size (ds ++ s2) ≡⟨ cong (d *_) (lemma-shape-size-product ds s2) ⟩
  d * (shape-size ds * shape-size s2) ≡⟨ sym (*-assoc d (shape-size ds) (shape-size s2)) ⟩
  (d * shape-size ds) * shape-size s2 ∎

lemma-shape-size-commutative-factor : ∀ (d : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) → d * shape-size s ≡ shape-size (d ∷ s)
lemma-shape-size-commutative-factor d s = refl

lemma-shape-size-cons-positive : ∀ (d : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) → 1 ≤ d → shape-size s ≤ shape-size (d ∷ s)
lemma-shape-size-cons-positive zero s ()
lemma-shape-size-cons-positive (suc d) s (s≤s z≤n) = m≤m+n (shape-size s) (d * shape-size s)

lemma-shape-size-append-positive : ∀ (s1 s2 : List ℕ) → shape-size s1 ≤ shape-size s1 * shape-size s2
lemma-shape-size-append-positive s1 s2 = m≤m+n (shape-size s1) ((shape-size s1) * (shape-size s2 ∸ 1))

theorem-tensor-mul-zero-left : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →

      Data.Vec.zipWith f (Data.Vec.replicate z) v ≡ Data.Vec.replicate z
    zipWith-replicate-left-absorb {zero} f z [] absorb = refl
    zipWith-replicate-left-absorb {suc n} f z (x ∷ xs) absorb = cong₂ _∷_ (absorb x) (zipWith-replicate-left-absorb f z xs absorb)

    zipWith-replicate-right-absorb : ∀ {n} (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) (z : ℚ) (v : Vec ℚ n) →

      Data.Vec.map (λ x → (s1 ℚ.* s2) ℚ.* x) v

    vec-assoc-helper {suc n} (x ∷ xs) = cong₂ _∷_ (*-assoc s1 s2 x) (vec-assoc-helper xs)

tensor-negate : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype

theorem-tensor-negate-involutive : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor-negate (tensor-negate t)) ≡ data-vec t
theorem-tensor-negate-involutive {Shape} {dtype} t = vec-negate-involutive-helper (data-vec t)
  where
    neg-involutive : ∀ (x : ℚ) → ℚ.- (ℚ.- x) ≡ x
    neg-involutive x = begin
      ℚ.- (ℚ.- x) ≡⟨ sym (proj₁ +-identity (ℚ.- (ℚ.- x))) ⟩
      0ℚ ℚ.+ (ℚ.- (ℚ.- x)) ≡⟨ cong (ℚ._+ (ℚ.- (ℚ.- x))) (sym (proj₂ +-inverse x)) ⟩
      (x ℚ.+ (ℚ.- x)) ℚ.+ (ℚ.- (ℚ.- x)) ≡⟨ +-assoc x (ℚ.- x) (ℚ.- (ℚ.- x)) ⟩
      x ℚ.+ ((ℚ.- x) ℚ.+ (ℚ.- (ℚ.- x))) ≡⟨ cong (x ℚ.+_) (proj₂ +-inverse (ℚ.- x)) ⟩
      x ℚ.+ 0ℚ ≡⟨ proj₂ +-identity x ⟩
      x ∎
    vec-negate-involutive-helper : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) →
      Data.Vec.map (ℚ.-_) (Data.Vec.map (ℚ.-_) v) ≡ v
    vec-negate-involutive-helper {zero} [] = refl
    vec-negate-involutive-helper {suc n} (x ∷ xs) = cong₂ _∷_ (neg-involutive x) (vec-negate-involutive-helper xs)

theorem-tensor-add-negate : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →

theorem-tensor-add-negate {Shape} {dtype} t = vec-add-negate-helper (data-vec t)
  where
    vec-add-negate-helper : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) →
      Data.Vec.zipWith (ℚ._+_) v (Data.Vec.map (ℚ.-_) v) ≡ Data.Vec.replicate 0ℚ
    vec-add-negate-helper {zero} [] = refl
    vec-add-negate-helper {suc n} (x ∷ xs) = cong₂ _∷_ (proj₂ +-inverse x) (vec-add-negate-helper xs)

tensor-sum : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →

  ℚ
tensor-sum t = tensor-fold (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ t

theorem-tensor-sum-zero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) →
  tensor-sum (tensor-zero Shape dtype) ≡ 0ℚ
theorem-tensor-sum-zero Shape dtype = vec-sum-zero-helper (shape-size Shape) (data-vec (tensor-zero Shape dtype))
  where
    vec-sum-zero-helper : ∀ (n : ℕ) (v : Vec ℚ n) →
      (∀ (i : Fin n) → Data.Vec.lookup i v ≡ 0ℚ) →
      Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v ≡ 0ℚ
    vec-sum-zero-helper zero [] all-zero = refl
    vec-sum-zero-helper (suc n) (x ∷ xs) all-zero = begin
      x ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs ≡⟨ cong (ℚ._+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs) (all-zero zero) ⟩
      0ℚ ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs ≡⟨ proj₁ +-identity (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs) ⟩
      Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs ≡⟨ vec-sum-zero-helper n xs (λ i → all-zero (suc i)) ⟩
      0ℚ ∎

theorem-tensor-sum-add : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  tensor-sum (tensor-add t1 t2) ≡ tensor-sum t1 ℚ.+ tensor-sum t2
theorem-tensor-sum-add {Shape} {dtype} t1 t2 = vec-sum-add-helper (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2)
  where
    vec-sum-add-helper : ∀ {n} (v1 v2 : Vec ℚ n) →
      Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (Data.Vec.zipWith (ℚ._+_) v1 v2) ≡
      Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v1 ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v2
    vec-sum-add-helper {zero} [] [] = sym (proj₁ +-identity 0ℚ)
    vec-sum-add-helper {suc n} (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = begin
      (x ℚ.+ y) ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (Data.Vec.zipWith (ℚ._+_) xs ys) ≡⟨ cong ((x ℚ.+ y) ℚ.+_) (vec-sum-add-helper xs ys) ⟩
      (x ℚ.+ y) ℚ.+ (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ ys) ≡⟨ sym (+-assoc (x ℚ.+ y) (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs) (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ ys)) ⟩
      ((x ℚ.+ y) ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs) ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ ys ≡⟨ cong (ℚ._+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ ys) (+-assoc x y (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs)) ⟩
      (x ℚ.+ (y ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs)) ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ ys ≡⟨ cong (λ z → (x ℚ.+ z) ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ ys) (+-comm y (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs)) ⟩
      (x ℚ.+ (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs ℚ.+ y)) ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ ys ≡⟨ cong (ℚ._+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ ys) (sym (+-assoc x (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs) y)) ⟩
      ((x ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs) ℚ.+ y) ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ ys ≡⟨ +-assoc (x ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs) y (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ ys) ⟩
      (x ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs) ℚ.+ (y ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ ys) ∎

theorem-tensor-sum-scalar-mul : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (s : ℚ) →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  tensor-sum (tensor-scalar-mul s t) ≡ s ℚ.* tensor-sum t
theorem-tensor-sum-scalar-mul {Shape} {dtype} s t = vec-sum-scalar-mul-helper (data-vec t)

    vec-sum-scalar-mul-helper : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) →
      Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (Data.Vec.map (λ x → s ℚ.* x) v) ≡
      s ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v
    vec-sum-scalar-mul-helper {zero} [] = sym (proj₂ *-identity s)
    vec-sum-scalar-mul-helper {suc n} (x ∷ xs) = begin
      (s ℚ.* x) ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (Data.Vec.map (λ y → s ℚ.* y) xs) ≡⟨ cong ((s ℚ.* x) ℚ.+_) (vec-sum-scalar-mul-helper xs) ⟩
      (s ℚ.* x) ℚ.+ (s ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs) ≡⟨ sym (*-distribˡ-+ s x (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs)) ⟩
      s ℚ.* (x ℚ.+ Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs) ∎

    vec-product-mul-helper {zero} [] [] = sym (proj₁ *-identity 1ℚ)
    vec-product-mul-helper {suc n} (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = begin
      (x ℚ.* y) ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ (Data.Vec.zipWith (ℚ._*_) xs ys) ≡⟨ cong ((x ℚ.* y) ℚ.*_) (vec-product-mul-helper xs ys) ⟩
      (x ℚ.* y) ℚ.* (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ xs ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ ys) ≡⟨ sym (*-assoc (x ℚ.* y) (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ xs) (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ ys)) ⟩
      ((x ℚ.* y) ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ xs) ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ ys ≡⟨ cong (ℚ._* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ ys) (*-assoc x y (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ xs)) ⟩
      (x ℚ.* (y ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ xs)) ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ ys ≡⟨ cong (λ z → (x ℚ.* z) ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ ys) (*-comm y (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ xs)) ⟩
      (x ℚ.* (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ xs ℚ.* y)) ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ ys ≡⟨ cong (ℚ._* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ ys) (sym (*-assoc x (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ xs) y)) ⟩
      ((x ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ xs) ℚ.* y) ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ ys ≡⟨ *-assoc (x ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ xs) y (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ ys) ⟩
      (x ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ xs) ℚ.* (y ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._*_) 1ℚ ys) ∎

tensor-all p t = Data.Vec.foldr _ (λ x acc → p x ∧ acc) true (data-vec t)

  (ℚ → Bool) →

theorem-tensor-all-true : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (p : ℚ → Bool) →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  tensor-all p t ≡ true →
  ∀ (i : Fin (shape-size Shape)) → p (Data.Vec.lookup i (data-vec t)) ≡ true
theorem-tensor-all-true {Shape} p t all-true i = vec-all-true-helper p (data-vec t) all-true i
  where
    vec-all-true-helper : ∀ {n} (pred : ℚ → Bool) (v : Vec ℚ n) →
      Data.Vec.foldr _ (λ x acc → pred x ∧ acc) true v ≡ true →
      ∀ (j : Fin n) → pred (Data.Vec.lookup j v) ≡ true
    vec-all-true-helper pred (x ∷ xs) prf zero with pred x | inspect pred x
    ... | true | [ eq ] = eq
    ... | false | [ eq ] rewrite eq = prf
    vec-all-true-helper pred (x ∷ xs) prf (suc j) with pred x | inspect pred x
    ... | true | [ eq ] = vec-all-true-helper pred xs prf j
    ... | false | [ eq ] rewrite eq = prf

theorem-tensor-any-false : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →

theorem-tensor-any-false {Shape} p t any-false i = vec-any-false-helper p (data-vec t) any-false i
  where
    vec-any-false-helper : ∀ {n} (pred : ℚ → Bool) (v : Vec ℚ n) →
      Data.Vec.foldr _ (λ x acc → pred x ∨ acc) false v ≡ false →
      ∀ (j : Fin n) → pred (Data.Vec.lookup j v) ≡ false
    vec-any-false-helper pred (x ∷ xs) prf zero with pred x | inspect pred x
    ... | true | [ eq ] rewrite eq = prf
    ... | false | [ eq ] = eq
    vec-any-false-helper pred (x ∷ xs) prf (suc j) with pred x | inspect pred x
    ... | true | [ eq ] rewrite eq = prf
    ... | false | [ eq ] = vec-any-false-helper pred xs prf j

  shape-size Shape1 ≡ shape-size Shape2 →
  Tensor Shape1 dtype →
  Tensor Shape2 dtype
tensor-reshape {Shape1} {Shape2} size-eq t = mkTensor (subst (Vec ℚ) size-eq (data-vec t)) (layout t) (device t) (ownership t) (refcount t)

theorem-tensor-reshape-preserves-data : ∀ {Shape1 Shape2 : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (size-eq : shape-size Shape1 ≡ shape-size Shape2) →
  (t : Tensor Shape1 dtype) →
  (i : Fin (shape-size Shape1)) →
  (j : Fin (shape-size Shape2)) →
  toℕ i ≡ toℕ j →
  Data.Vec.lookup i (data-vec t) ≡ Data.Vec.lookup j (data-vec (tensor-reshape size-eq t))
theorem-tensor-reshape-preserves-data {Shape1} {Shape2} refl t i j idx-eq = cong (λ k → Data.Vec.lookup k (data-vec t)) (toℕ-injective idx-eq)
  where
    toℕ-injective : ∀ {n} {i j : Fin n} → toℕ i ≡ toℕ j → i ≡ j
    toℕ-injective {suc n} {zero} {zero} eq = refl
    toℕ-injective {suc n} {zero} {suc j} ()
    toℕ-injective {suc n} {suc i} {zero} ()
    toℕ-injective {suc n} {suc i} {suc j} eq = cong suc (toℕ-injective {n} {i} {j} (cong pred eq))

tensor-transpose-2d : ∀ {m n : ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor (m ∷ n ∷ []) dtype →
  Tensor (n ∷ m ∷ []) dtype
tensor-transpose-2d {m} {n} {dtype} t = tensor-reshape (*-comm m n) (record t { data-vec = transposed-data })
  where
    transposed-data : Vec ℚ (m * n)
    transposed-data = Data.Vec.tabulate (λ i → Data.Vec.lookup (transpose-index m n i) (data-vec t))
    transpose-index : ∀ (rows cols : ℕ) → Fin (rows * cols) → Fin (rows * cols)
    transpose-index rows cols i = subst Fin (*-comm rows cols) (fromℕ< (transpose-bounds rows cols i))
      where
        transpose-bounds : ∀ (r c : ℕ) (idx : Fin (r * c)) → (toℕ idx / r + (toℕ idx Data.Nat.∸ (toℕ idx / r) * r) * c) < (c * r)
        transpose-bounds r c idx = {!!}

theorem-tensor-slice-lookup : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (start len : ℕ) →
  (prf : start + len ≤ shape-size Shape) →

tensor-concat {Shape1} {Shape2} {dtype} t1 t2 = mkTensor (data-vec t1 Data.Vec.++ data-vec t2) (layout t1) (device t1) OWNED 1

theorem-tensor-concat-lookup-left : ∀ {Shape1 Shape2 : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →

tensor-eq : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Bool
tensor-eq t1 t2 = vec-eq-helper (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2)
  where
    vec-eq-helper : ∀ {n} → Vec ℚ n → Vec ℚ n → Bool
    vec-eq-helper [] [] = true
    vec-eq-helper (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = decToBool (x Data.Rational.≟ y) ∧ vec-eq-helper xs ys

theorem-tensor-eq-refl : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  tensor-eq t t ≡ true
theorem-tensor-eq-refl t = vec-eq-refl-helper (data-vec t)
  where
    vec-eq-refl-helper : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) →
      (let vec-eq-helper : Vec ℚ n → Vec ℚ n → Bool
           vec-eq-helper [] [] = true
           vec-eq-helper (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = decToBool (x Data.Rational.≟ y) ∧ vec-eq-helper xs ys
       in vec-eq-helper v v) ≡ true
    vec-eq-refl-helper [] = refl
    vec-eq-refl-helper (x ∷ xs) with x Data.Rational.≟ x
    ... | yes prf = vec-eq-refl-helper xs
    ... | no contra = ⊥-elim (contra refl)

theorem-tensor-eq-sym : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  tensor-eq t1 t2 ≡ tensor-eq t2 t1
theorem-tensor-eq-sym t1 t2 = vec-eq-sym-helper (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2)
  where
    vec-eq-helper : ∀ {n} → Vec ℚ n → Vec ℚ n → Bool
    vec-eq-helper [] [] = true
    vec-eq-helper (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = decToBool (x Data.Rational.≟ y) ∧ vec-eq-helper xs ys
    vec-eq-sym-helper : ∀ {n} (v1 v2 : Vec ℚ n) →
      vec-eq-helper v1 v2 ≡ vec-eq-helper v2 v1
    vec-eq-sym-helper [] [] = refl
    vec-eq-sym-helper (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) with x Data.Rational.≟ y | y Data.Rational.≟ x
    ... | yes p1 | yes p2 = vec-eq-sym-helper xs ys
    ... | yes p1 | no c2 = ⊥-elim (c2 (sym p1))
    ... | no c1 | yes p2 = ⊥-elim (c1 (sym p2))
